_comment: E4 Q12 hard condition. The published @convoso/ai-agent may expose ONLY what the widget's WebRTC client (voice.ts + api.ts) had on 2026-09-23, plus the vendor-parity Conversation façade. Staff-only capabilities live in the private @convoso/ai-agent-internal. Extend a list only with an owner-ruled reason in the same commit.

Authorization.pattern: Base headers for every call — the preview's Authorization only|headers\.Authorization = `Bearer \$\{this\.authToken\}`
Authorization.why: today's widget: the element's auth-token attribute (settings live preview of a disabled widget)
the vendor's `authorization` option: the customer's own bearer on the token request for a private agent
owner ruling Q16 (P2): postOverallFeedback's optional bearer — the vendor-path feedback route authenticates with the customer's own API key

session_token.pattern: const \{ session_id, session_token, conversation_id \} = answer;|return \{ session_id, session_token, conversation_id: conversation_id \?\? "" \};
session_token.why: a token offer's answer carries the disconnect proof (E4 P1, commit 1.4)

recvonly.why: Q19 text-only session: no microphone, the answer still negotiates audio
